root_cause.text: In FUSE readdir caching, fuse_add_dirent_to_cache() trusted the server-controlled dirent name length to compute reclen and copied the serialized dirent into a single page-cache page without validating that the dirent itself was no larger than PAGE_SIZE, causing a page overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The commit/CVE states the code “only checks whether the dirent fits in the remaining space of the current page and advances to a fresh page if not” but “never checks whether the dirent itself exceeds PAGE_SIZE,” and the fix adds `if (reclen > PAGE_SIZE) return;` before copying.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a size guard in fuse_add_dirent_to_cache() to skip caching directory entries that exceed a cache page.
intent_record.what: A new early-return check was added in fuse_add_dirent_to_cache() to compare reclen against PAGE_SIZE, with a comment explaining that directory entries larger than a readdir cache page should not be cached.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now skips caching any directory entry whose record length exceeds a single page, preventing attempts to place an oversized dirent into the readdir cache page and avoiding invalid page-sized cache handling.
